Cashfire 2

Any reel. Any order.

Count every loot box across all four reels. They do not need to be next to each other or start on reel 1.

Each reel independently has a 20% chance of a loot box. Three loot boxes on any reels start Shooting Spree. Four start Mega Shooting Spree. Follow the operation, then see your winnings at the end. Pause, mute, skip and media recovery do not change the reel result. This is a prototype using demo credits. The full bonus pays one prize, including returned stake; there is no extra bet. The paytable and last return show total credits returned, including any returned stake. Net is the return minus your bet. A return below 1× loses part of your bet.
